summary_md: **Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2116214928482947512))** highlights **nesformer**, which compiles the NES 6502 CPU and 2 KB RAM directly into a stock Qwen3.5 model's weights without training, running Super Mario Bros 1-1 frame-exact at 1–6 s per frame ([dbreunig/nesformer](https://github.com/dbreunig/nesformer)).
